newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee futures still down after see-saw NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee futures still down after see-saw NY.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures stayed mostly in the minus territory and near session lows by the close on Friday despite a sharp jump in New York.
Traders said a bout of origin selling and speculative profit-taking continued to pound the market lower after a slight recovery in late afternoon on New York's strength.
Scale-down speculative and trade buying provided an immediate floor.
By the finish, May lost $19 at $1,590 a tonne while July shed $16 at $1,628.
The front-mont May came under further long liquidation after triggered sell-stops at $1,600. July noted light fund selling earlier in the day.
But scale-down roaster interest at the lows helped cushion the fall.
The selling in May widened May/July switches to a high of $78 from Thursday's $40. It closed at $38.
New York's July cleared the physological $2.00 a lb barrier to hit a new contract high of 203.50 cents before news of the end of a six-day Colombian truckers strike took it lower again.
London's May/May arbitrage with New York widened to a record $1.47 on Friday.
